name: Daiunji Eru
source:
She is the daughter of the “Daiunji Zaibatsu” who built up a large conglomerate in the bio-industry. She has never had a problem with money, so she believes that everything that happens in the world can be solved with money.

Her ability is to gain control over others. To activate it, the person must touch something she cast her ability on. Those who fall for it will do whatever she tells them to do. Because it is a very tricky ability, the process of setting it up is difficult, and she tends to solve it with money, because her parents told her that “everything" is about money. 

Her ability can be weak without the proper knowledge, and when she encounters a situation where money is not an option, she gets upset and becomes irrational. To overcome this, she is sent to the "special" classroom.

She is a high flier, and thinks that money is the most important thing in the world. She is quick to anger and quick to judge, however, once she likes you she is very devoted.

P/A: Avarice

Hobbies: Shopping for brand name items, spending money
Special skill: Spending money
Likes: Spending money, people who like her, sachertorte
Dislikes: Dirty things, people who don't like her


[From [url=https://www.empress-game.com/PA/top.html]official site[/url]]
